record.question: Where was the auction for the world's most expensive crab that was sold for $46,000.00 takes place?
record.explanation: Answer D: Japan. The Tottori Prefectural Fisheries Cooperative Karo Branch in Tottori, Japan, held the auction on 7 November 2019. The prefecture’s own release records the 5-million-yen crab sale. Reference: https://db.pref.tottori.jp/movement_2019.nsf/webview_forNewCms/C10E6B08702D65E6492584EB000A8F52. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
